title: MERIDIAN — A Claude Copilot Adventure
excerpt: Everyone else made the escape pods. You didn't. Learn Claude Code by actually flying: write a real Skill, dispatch a real Agent, and find out where its line is.
content_html:
A Claude Copilot Adventure

Your ship is failing and the crew is gone. All that's left is you and the onboard AI. Learn to work with it — one prompt, one skill, one autonomous agent at a time — and you both make it home.

headphones optional · ~8 minutes · every code sample is real
